note: systemd units shipped into the image whose ExecStart names a program the build does not install. This file exists so that such a gap is recorded rather than discovered as a container-verification failure mixed in with environment noise. A unit not listed here whose program is absent fails repository validation.

gaps.finding: The unit runs the base image's dbus-daemon with anaconda's own bus configuration; the repository ships the unit and the readiness program but has no reason to ship dbus itself.
gaps.impact: None expected: dbus is a hard dependency of systemd and anaconda-core, both unconditionally present in every profile this unit ships on. The unit is live-media-only (ConditionPathExists on the live-session marker) and its absence surfaces as 'destructive executor is unavailable', which is the fail-closed path Journey A run 11 measured.
gaps.notFixedHere: Shipping a second copy of dbus would be wrong, not incomplete.

gaps.finding: build/scripts/install-root.py copies systemd/ wholesale into /usr/lib/systemd/system, so the unit ships, but no step installs the program it starts. enterprise/policy.py is a library, not an executable.
gaps.impact: On an installed system the unit would fail to start. It is guarded by ConditionPathExists=/etc/bunny-os/enrolment.json, so it does not run on an unenrolled device, which is every device today: no enrolment has been performed and the enterprise pilot gate is BLOCKED.
gaps.notFixedHere: Writing the agent would be a new product feature. This pass is CI portability repair and hosted independent-build execution.
